ai.definition: Runway ML is an AI platform designed to enable non-technical users to create and deploy machine learning models by providing a user-friendly interface that bypasses the need for writing code.
ai.howItWorks: Users can upload data, select pre-built components or modules from a library, customize them as needed, and then train and deploy the model directly through an intuitive web-based interface. The platform handles all the underlying complexities of machine learning, including model optimization and deployment infrastructure.
ai.problemSolved: The primary problem Runway ML solves is the high barrier to entry for non-technical users who want to leverage machine learning but lack programming skills or domain expertise in AI.
ai.manufacturing: Manufacturing involves developing a robust backend that can handle various types of data and models, ensuring scalability and performance. The platform must also integrate with cloud services for hosting and scaling the deployed models.
ai.buildProcess: The build process includes designing an intuitive UI/UX, integrating machine learning algorithms, creating a library of pre-built components, testing the platform’s capabilities, and continuously updating it based on user feedback and technological advancements.
ai.costDrivers: Cost drivers include the infrastructure costs for hosting and scaling models, maintaining the backend systems, and providing support to users. The cost also depends on the complexity and size of the models being deployed.
ai.lifecycleOutlook: The outlook is positive as more businesses seek to integrate AI without requiring specialized technical knowledge. However, competition from other no-code/low-code platforms could pose challenges.
ai.regulation: Regulations related to data privacy and model transparency will impact the platform’s design and deployment capabilities. Compliance with GDPR, CCPA, and other data protection laws is crucial.
ai.risks: Risks include maintaining user trust in the platform's accuracy and reliability, ensuring compliance with evolving regulations, and keeping up with rapid technological advancements in AI.
ai.profitability: Profitability depends on subscription fees for access to the platform, additional services like model optimization, and potential revenue from partnerships or integrations with other technologies.
ai.futureDevelopment: Future development will likely focus on expanding the library of pre-built components, enhancing model performance, integrating more advanced AI techniques, and improving user experience.

glossary.def: Software tools that allow users to build applications without writing code or with minimal coding.
The server-side components of a web application, including databases and application logic.

subsystems.name: Data pipeline
subsystems.role: turns raw video and its captions into training material.

subsystems.name: Latent video model
subsystems.role: compresses video into a compact representation the generator can work in.

subsystems.name: Generative core
subsystems.role: produces new frames that follow a text or image prompt.

subsystems.name: Control layer
subsystems.role: lets a person steer the output rather than re-roll until lucky.

subsystems.name: Serving stack
subsystems.role: runs the model fast enough to be usable and bills for it.

subsystems.name: Web editor
subsystems.role: the browser workspace where clips are generated, cut and exported.

subsystems.name: Safety and provenance
subsystems.role: limits misuse and marks synthetic output.

buildSteps.title: Assemble a video–text corpus
buildSteps.detail: Clips are collected, deduplicated, segmented into a few seconds each and paired with descriptive captions; licensing and consent are checked.

buildSteps.title: Train a video autoencoder
buildSteps.detail: A network learns to squeeze frames — and their motion — into a small latent code and reconstruct them, so the generator never has to work pixel by pixel.

buildSteps.title: Train the diffusion transformer
buildSteps.detail: Starting from noise in latent space, the model learns to denoise toward a video that matches its caption, with temporal layers keeping motion coherent.

buildSteps.title: Align the text encoder
buildSteps.detail: Prompts and clips are pulled into a shared meaning space so that words like 'dolly shot' or 'neon-lit rain' reliably change the output.

buildSteps.title: Add control and fine-tuning
buildSteps.detail: Image prompts, masks and motion controls are trained in, and the model is tuned with curated examples for cinematic quality.

buildSteps.title: Compress inference
buildSteps.detail: Distillation, quantisation and better samplers cut the number of denoising steps so a clip renders in seconds to minutes rather than hours.

buildSteps.title: Wrap it in an editor
buildSteps.detail: Generation is embedded in a timeline-based web app so users can generate, extend, cut and composite without leaving the browser.

buildSteps.title: Deploy and moderate
buildSteps.detail: Model versions are served behind an API with job queues and rate limits, alongside content filters and provenance marking.

prerequisites.why: video models need orders of magnitude more compute than image models.
the transformer-plus-diffusion recipe is behind today's commercial text-to-video systems.
high-quality footage with clear licences is scarce and legally contested.
objects and faces drift or morph after a few seconds, which limits usable shot length.
without them, synthetic footage is hard to distinguish from real recordings.

pathway.milestone: commercial text-to-video and video-to-video models (Runway's Gen-series and rivals)
pathway.unlocks: short synthetic shots for ads, storyboards and visual effects plates.

pathway.milestone: minute-scale clips with synchronised audio and consistent characters
pathway.unlocks: usable scenes rather than isolated shots.

pathway.milestone: generation integrated into professional editing and effects pipelines
pathway.unlocks: synthetic reshoots, crowd and background replacement at production scale.
video produced by directing a model rather than filming at all.
